run.status: held: Cannot set property code of  which has only a getter

cause: Retry handler assigns to error.code; native DOMException exposes a read-only getter. The original native error name was not saved because the handler itself threw. Native TimeoutError and AbortError regression fixtures reproduce this class of failure.
fix: Wrap native transport errors with the original cause and a writable retry code. Persist failed status before the single same-model retry. Retain unknown charges.
limitations: No accepted annual. Resume must retain the saved PDF and entire journal with original $2 cap. Publisher policy hashes change with the adapter; old answers are not silently rekeyed.
